the aging of the arteries and brain and its impact on the risk and outcome of stroke and dementia.

stroke and the aging of both the arteries and the brain are a complex interplay of many risk factors that can be reduced by a multifaceted approach.
stroke and its treatment are a major determinant of the aging process and the quality of life in old age.
stroke is a major cause of morbidity and mortality in the elderly.

the risk of stroke is increased in older people, but that it can be reduced by aggressive treatment of the risk factors and early intervention when the stroke has occurred.

stroke is an age-related disease that can be prevented by early diagnosis and treatment of its risk factors.

stroke is a major public health problem that can be reduced by prevention and early aggressive treatment.
